parsed.rationale: The rhythm strip shows an irregularly irregular narrow-complex rhythm at about 120-130 bpm with no clear P waves and a fibrillatory baseline (best seen in V1), so this is not normal despite the similar case you saw. Precordial voltages are high, with deep S in V3 and tall R in V4-V5, and there is no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
